app.name: Agent Platform
app.description: A secure AI assistant running inside your organization's infrastructure

auth.title: Welcome to Agent Platform
auth.description: Sign in with your organization account to start a conversation with the assistant.

memory.title: Assistant memory
memory.description: The assistant saves what is worth remembering about you from your conversations, such as your preferences and work context, and uses it in later conversations. This memory is yours alone.
memory.enabledHint: Memory is on: the assistant saves what is worth remembering and uses it in its answers.
memory.disabledHint: Memory is off: the assistant saves nothing new and does not use what was saved. Saved items stay until you delete them.
memory.empty: Nothing is saved in your memory.
memory.deleted: The item was deleted from your memory.

policies.title: Guard policies
policies.description: These policies control what enters the assistant, what leaves it and what is stored in memory, at the seven checkpoints. Every edit is saved as a new version and reaches every server within two seconds, without a restart.
policies.select: Choose a policy from the list to view and test it, or create a new one.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.description: The capacity and time limit values the administrator sets. The defaults come from the configuration files; every save is a new version that can be reverted, and it applies to requests that start after it.
settings.versionFiles: In force: the defaults from the configuration files.
settings.ignored: The saved version is not applied: it breaks the timeout rules since the configuration files changed, so the defaults are in force. Save valid values or restore the defaults.

groupHints.turns: Limits on questions in progress, and a question's time limit from its arrival to the end of its answer.
groupHints.models: The longest each model call waits before it is cut.
groupHints.uploads: Upload limits per user and per tenant.
groupHints.mcp: Concurrent requests to each tool server; they may be lowered, never raised above the file's value.
groupHints.capacity: These values change only with a redeploy, not from this page.
groupHints.tree: Every inner time limit must end before the one around it.
groupHints.usage: Refreshed every five seconds while the page is open. Counts only, no user names or ids.
groupHints.history: Every save and revert is a new version; nothing is deleted.

settings.defaultNone: Default: no limit of its own
settings.noLimit: No limit of its own (the platform's capacity applies)

tenants.none: No tenant has a limit of its own.

problems.range: The value must be from {minimum} to {maximum}.
problems.tenant: The tenant id is not valid.

turn_per_user_max.label: Questions in progress per user
turn_per_user_max.help: How many questions one user may have in progress at once. Example: 2 refuses a third until one of the two ends.

turn_per_tenant_max.label: Questions in progress per tenant
turn_per_tenant_max.help: Each tenant's share of the questions in progress. Example: 10 per tenant, or no limit of its own so the platform's capacity applies.

turn_per_tenant_overrides.label: Limits for specific tenants
turn_per_tenant_overrides.help: A limit for one tenant in place of the general one. Example: one tenant with 15.

turn_deadline_s.label: Whole-question time limit
turn_deadline_s.help: The longest a question may take, from its arrival to the end of its answer; then it is stopped. Example: 120.

turn_answer_reserve_s.label: Time kept for the answer
turn_answer_reserve_s.help: Time kept for the answer and what follows it, however long the capabilities before it take. Example: 45.

turn_post_answer_reserve_s.label: Time kept after the answer
turn_post_answer_reserve_s.help: Time kept after the answer's last word for checks, saving and memory. Example: 30.

turn_evidence_fetch_s.label: Time to fetch the sources' text
turn_evidence_fetch_s.help: The longest time to fetch the sources' text before the answer; past it the answer goes on without what did not arrive. Example: 10.

models_helper_s.label: Helper models' time limit
models_helper_s.help: The time limit of each routing, summary, judging and extraction call. Example: 20.

models_reasoning_s.label: Answering model's time limit
models_reasoning_s.help: The time limit of each answering and reflection call. Example: 90.

models_embed_query_s.label: Time to embed a question
models_embed_query_s.help: The time limit to embed a question or a memory item for a search. Example: 15.

models_embed_batch_s.label: Time to embed a batch of file passages
models_embed_batch_s.help: The time limit to embed one batch of an uploaded file's passages while it is indexed. Example: 60.

models_rerank_s.label: Time to rerank results
models_rerank_s.help: The time limit to rerank file passages by their relevance to the question. Example: 20.

docs_max_concurrent_uploads.label: Uploads in progress per user
docs_max_concurrent_uploads.help: How many files one user may upload at once. Example: 2.

docs_max_concurrent_uploads_per_tenant.label: Uploads in progress per tenant
docs_max_concurrent_uploads_per_tenant.help: Each tenant's share of the uploads in progress. Example: 20, or no limit of its own.

docs_tenant_concurrent_uploads.label: Upload limits for specific tenants
docs_tenant_concurrent_uploads.help: An upload limit for one tenant in place of the general one. Example: one tenant with 5.

docs_uploads_per_minute.label: Uploads per minute per user
docs_uploads_per_minute.help: How many files one user may upload in any minute. Example: 20.

docs_register_response_s.label: Time an upload waits for its answer
docs_register_response_s.help: How long an upload waits for the file to be taken before it answers that it is being processed. Example: 20.

mcp_max_concurrency.label: Concurrent requests to the tool server
mcp_max_concurrency.help: How many requests are sent to it at once; it may be lowered, never raised above the file's value agreed with the server's owner. Example: 6.

review.title: What will change
review.valid: Every timeout rule holds after this change.
review.stale: The values changed after the review; review them again before saving.
review.saved: Version {version} is saved; it applies to requests that start from now.

tree.previewing: The tree shows the values after the proposed change, before it is saved.

rules.turn-in-relay: The question's time limit within the gateway's relay limit
rules.headers-in-relay: The wait for the reply to start within the relay limit
rules.admission-in-headers: Admitting the question before the gateway stops waiting for the reply
rules.answer-reserve-in-turn: The time kept for the answer within the question's time limit
rules.post-answer-in-answer-reserve: The time kept after the answer within the time kept for it
rules.persist-in-post-answer: Saving the conversation within the time kept after the answer
rules.judge-and-persist-in-post-answer: Judging then saving within the time kept after the answer
rules.evidence-in-room: Fetching the sources' text within the time before the answer
rules.reasoning-in-turn: The answering model's call within the question's time limit
rules.litellm-backstop-in-longest-call: The model gateway's backstop within the longest model time limit
rules.helper-in-shortest-capability: The helper models within the shortest capability time limit
rules.register-in-gateway-call: An upload's answer within the gateway's limit for platform requests
rules.upload-stall-in-deadline: An upload's stall within the time to receive the whole file
rules.keep-alive: The gateway's idle connection shorter than the agent service's
rules.keep-alive-dev: The gateway's idle connection shorter than the agent service's in development
rules.capability-in-room: The capability's time limit within the time before the answer
rules.tool-in-capability: The tool's time limit within its capability's
rules.facade-search-in-tool: A file search within the tool's time limit
rules.document-server-in-tool: A document server call within the tool's time limit
rules.slot-and-attempt-in-broker: A tool server's wait and attempt within the broker's limit

labels.lock_pool_size: The platform's capacity of questions at once

labels.mem_limit_mcp-rag-ref: Memory limit of the reference document server
labels.sandbox_cpu_seconds: Processing time of one file parser
labels.sandbox_timeout_seconds: Time limit of one file parser
labels.sandbox_parent_reserve_mb: Memory kept for the indexing service itself
labels.turn_gateway_margin_s: The gateway's margin after the question's time limit
labels.keep_alive_gateway_s: How long the gateway keeps an idle connection to the agent
labels.keep_alive_agent_s: How long the agent service keeps an idle connection
